supersedes_only: Original host-context-checkpoint.json pointer origin and persistent projection details; original packet, actual copied-pointer counterexample and authentic absent-module RED remain immutable.
accepted_layouts: Direct owned physical root/.git directory with git_dir=common_dir=root/.git; or actual registered linked worktree with root/.git regular forward pointer, git_dir != common_dir and dirname(git_dir)=common_dir/worktrees. Refuse separate-git-dir, bare and submodule layouts without an authenticated reciprocal registered-worktree association. This helper does not repair Git layouts.

links.git_entry: Existing bounded owned single-linked nofollow root/.git regular file. Exactly gitdir: <nonempty UTF8 path> plus LF; no NUL/CR/embedded LF. Resolve relative to root; require realpath equals exact canonical admitted git_dir.
links.git_backlink: Required actual git_dir/gitdir bounded4096-byte owned single-linked regular nofollow file. Exactly nonempty UTF8 path plus LF, no NUL/CR/embedded LF. Resolve relative to git_dir per Git relative worktree semantics; require resolved lexical path and realpath both equal exact admitted root/.git. Pin byte hash plus file identity before/after every repository probe and context read.
links.commondir: Required actual git_dir/commondir same bounded nofollow file contract. Resolve relative to git_dir; require realpath equals exact admitted common_dir. Pin byte hash plus file identity before/after every repository probe and context read.
links.registry_parent: Require common_dir/worktrees owned canonical nonsymlink non-group/world-writable directory. Pin its directory identity for active context; directory mtime/ctime excluded. Registered admin git_dir must be an immediate physical child. Direct .git directory needs no backlink/commondir; both fields null.

derivation: Use the exact original canonicalJson and SHA256 formulas, now with precisely the amended projection fields. New four backlink/commondir fields null for direct .git directory; linked files use original complete file identity (masked permission mode, dev,ino,birthtime_ns,uid,size_bytes,mtime_ns,ctime_ns) and raw-byte SHA256. No other persistent fields. Registry parent separately active-pinned. Same HEAD/private namespace rules unchanged.
error_precedence: Unknown/cloned/Proxy/disposed membership first without getters; inherited forbidden environment ENVIRONMENT_INVALID; capture malformed repository/pins INVALID, unsupported runtime UNAVAILABLE, unavailable clock CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE; on member reads any repository/pin/runtime/boot mismatch or failure STALE, then clock sampling failure CLOCK_UNAVAILABLE. Disposal of nonmembers is harmless.
